title: Aileen Villas Layan
shortDescription: Phase 5 of the Aileen Villas Layan community by Trinity Property, offering 3 and 4 bedroom private-pool villas of roughly 270 to 470 sqm.
description: Phase 5 of the Aileen Villas Layan community by Trinity Property, offering 3 and 4 bedroom private-pool villas of roughly 270 to 470 sqm. Larger types add a terrace pool or extra laundry and storage rooms. Sources disagree on whether the phase is finished or still to be completed.
